I am taking my time to write this review because, quite frankly, this course was a  waste of time. We have 6 hours per week of this course, but most time students do not learn anything in class because as fourth year students, there is actually not much to learn. We already know how to write a research paper and how to make sound arguments and having 6 hours per week where we re-learn this, seems to me like a waste of our time, the instructor's time and a waste of university resources. This was clearly shown when we watched movies in class because the teacher did not know what to teach-i honestly, do no blame her for this.  In addition, for a course that is 6 credits, basing it on group work just seems incredibly unfair to me. In my group, another student and i were the only ones that actually did any work, and the remaining group members (4 people) just watched idly by. This course was unbelievably frustrating, as we were meant to rely on each other and every single time, we did, it would have dire consequences. I strongly believe, and many others that i have spoken to,  that for future generations, GE 400 should be based on individual work. The schedule should revolve around meeting the professors individually, maybe 4-6 times, during the semester in which they give you advice on the research you are working on. I would have much rather have an additional elective or course in my curriculum and meet the advisors according to their availability, than wasting my time watching movies and discussing personal life stories with them.
